title: Topic 8: Time, Days & Dates - Reading
description: Two short texts with three questions each.
canDoStatement: Tell the time, say days and months, give simple dates

readingBlock.readingText:
TEXT A - Weekly schedule format
MY WEEK - by Lika
Monday: I study English at seven o'clock.
Wednesday: I work in the morning.
Friday: I watch TV with my sister at night.
Sunday: I sleep! Sunday is my happy day.
What is your week like?

TEXT B - Invitation card format
COME TO MY BIRTHDAY!
My birthday is in May, and the party is on Saturday!
Where: my house
What time: four o'clock
There is food and music!
Please come - it is my special day.
- Vado
